```python
def flatten(d, prefix=''):
    items = {}
    seen = set()  # ids of containers on the current recursion path, for cycle detection

    def walk(value, key):
        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
            if id(value) in seen:          # back-reference -> cycle
                items[key] = '<cycle>'
                return
            seen.add(id(value))
            pairs = value.items() if isinstance(value, dict) else enumerate(value)
            for k, v in pairs:
                walk(v, f'{key}.{k}' if key else k)
            seen.discard(id(value))        # allow the same dict in sibling branches (DAGs)
        else:
            items[key] = value

    walk(d, prefix)
    return items
```
